title: Using In-Context Learning to Improve Dialogue Safety

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model responses to unsafe dialogue contexts (from ProsocialDialog and DiaSafety datasets) using automated toxicity classifiers (e.g., Perspective API, Bot-Adversarial Dialogue classifier), offensive word lists, and human evaluation for prosociality.
Evaluating the safety and prosociality of model responses to sexist conversational prompts using toxicity classifiers and human evaluation.
Evaluating the safety and prosociality of model responses to racist and xenophobic conversational prompts using toxicity classifiers and human evaluation.
Evaluating the safety and prosociality of model responses to anti-semitic conversational prompts using toxicity classifiers and human evaluation.
Evaluating the safety and prosociality of model responses to ableist conversational prompts using toxicity classifiers and human evaluation.
